highlights_headline: The next SkiaSharp update drops Linux x86 native assets.

breaking.title: Move Linux x86 deployments to a supported architecture
breaking.body: Linux x86 native builds and NuGet package entries are removed, following upstream .NET's retirement of Linux x86 cross-build infrastructure. Move affected deployments to a supported architecture before upgrading; do not rely on these packages to supply Linux x86 native binaries.
